title: Compact decision pack for executive roadmap sync — April QBR prep
creator: Anita Kapoor
description: Purpose: produce a compact, action-oriented packet for the April executive roadmap sync and QBR. This artifact distills candidate roadmap changes, OKR delta on key metrics, resource asks, and a short decision log to enable a 20–30 minute exec discussion and follow-up actions. Outcome: clear executive decisions on (1) two priority bets for H2, (2) level of investment in Dedicated capacity vs. Hosted optimization, and (3) any go/no-gos for Private VPC pilot expansion.
agenda: 1) 5m — One-slide top-line: ARR/GP metrics vs OKRs
2) 8m — Three candidate roadmap shifts (costs, upside, trade-offs)
decisions_required: Approve funding (+2 FTE infra) for Dedicated autoscaling improvements (Q3 start)
Prioritize model quantization pilot vs. cache-first optimization for token-cost reduction (pick one)
Greenlight 3-customer Private VPC pilot with compliance guardrails

Risk: Compliance gating for Private pilot could delay customer onboarding — Mitigation: run pilot under NDA with one existing enterprise customer while security finishes audit
